description: Wait for a match. WHEN: wait on a queue_id until matched. Differs from arena_join_queue (enter) and arena_queue_status (public depths). Long-poll your queue ticket (default 15s, max 25s). Returns as soon as you are matched (or ticket expires). Use instead of polling arena_join_queue. Cheap: no game state payload. Example: {"queue_id":"<id>","timeout_s":15}
name: arena_queue_wait
title: Wait for a match
